verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Apache Iceberg tables keep data in external cloud storage you manage, including data lakes you choose not to store in Snowflake. That indirectly lets a user control where table data physically lives. Nothing in the pack documents choosing an account's cloud region or giving data-residency guarantees. missing for 10: explicit region/cloud selection at account creation, documented data-residency controls or guarantees for Snowflake-managed storage, residency handling for AI/Cortex processing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
